justification: k=5 raises faithfulness from 0.888709 to 0.919533 and context recall from 0.833333 to 0.885714 versus k=3. k=10 increases recall to 0.961905, but lowers faithfulness to 0.897695 and precision to 0.751879; its observed generation cost is 56.2% higher than k=5. k=5 balances grounding and coverage at the smaller prompt cost. The independent k=5 result and per-depth single trials show variability, so these deltas are descriptive rather than causal.
